en.t: The Roman usurper Nepotianus, of the Constantinian dynasty, proclaims himself Roman emperor, entering Rome at the head of a group of gladiators
en.s: The Constantinian dynasty is an informal name for the ruling family of the Roman Empire from Constantius Chlorus (died 306) to the death of Julian in 363. It is named after its most famous member, Constantine the Great, who became the sole ruler of the empire in 324. The dynasty is also called Neo-Flavian because every Constantinian emperor bore the name Flavius, similarly to the rulers of the first Flavian dynasty in the 1st century.

zh.t: 罗马篡位者涅波提安努斯自立为皇帝，率一群角斗士进入罗马
zh.s: 君士坦丁王朝是对罗马帝国统治家族的非正式称呼，统治时期从君士坦提乌斯·克洛鲁斯（306年去世）至朱利安于363年去世。王朝以最著名的成员君士坦丁大帝命名，他于324年成为帝国唯一统治者。该王朝也称新弗拉维王朝，因为每位君士坦丁王朝皇帝都使用“弗拉维乌斯”之名，类似于公元1世纪的弗拉维王朝统治者。

en.t: The French scholar Peter Abelard is found guilty of heresy
en.s: Peter Abelard (12 February 1079 – 21 April 1142) was a French philosopher, logician, theologian, composer, and poet, regarded as one of the most brilliant and controversial theologians of his time. Born at Pallet, near Nantes, he became a popular lecturer in Paris, but his academic career was cut short after his love affair with his student and eventual wife, Héloïse d'Argenteuil.

zh.t: 法国学者彼得·阿伯拉尔被判异端
zh.s: 彼得·阿伯拉尔（1079年2月12日—1142年4月21日）是法国哲学家、逻辑学家、神学家、作曲家和诗人，被视为当时最杰出、也最具争议的神学家之一。他出生于南特附近的帕莱，后来在巴黎成为受欢迎的讲师；但他与学生、后来成为妻子的埃洛伊丝·达让特伊的恋情，使他的学术生涯中断。

en.s: The Treaty of Novgorod (Russian: Новгородско-норвежский договор, romanized: Novgorodsko-norvezhskiy dogovor; Norwegian: Novgorod-traktaten) was a 10-year peace treaty signed on 3 June 1326 in Novgorod. It marked the end of decades of border skirmishes between Norway and Novgorod in the far northern region of Finnmark. A few years earlier, in 1323, Novgorod had settled its conflict with Sweden in the Treaty of Nöteborg.

zh.s: 1326年6月3日，挪威与诺夫哥罗德在诺夫哥罗德签署为期10年的和平条约，结束了双方在遥远北方芬马克地区持续数十年的边境冲突。该条约的俄语名称为“Новгородско-норвежский договор”，罗马字转写为“Novgorodsko-norvezhskiy dogovor”；挪威语名称为“Novgorod-traktaten”。几年前的1323年，诺夫哥罗德已通过《涅博尔条约》解决与瑞典的冲突。

en.s: The Battle of Bangkusay (Filipino: Labanan sa Ilog Bangkusay; Spanish: Batalla de Bangkusay), on June 3, 1571, was a naval engagement in Bangkusay Channel off the coast of Tondo that marked the last resistance by locals to the Spanish Empire's occupation and colonization of the Pasig River delta, which had been the site of the indigenous polities of the Rajahnate of Maynila and Tondo.

zh.s: 1571年6月3日，邦库赛海峡发生海战，当地名称为“Labanan sa Ilog Bangkusay”，西班牙语名称为“Batalla de Bangkusay”。这场战斗标志着当地势力对西班牙帝国占领和殖民帕西格河三角洲的最后抵抗。该三角洲曾是马尼拉王国和通都王国等本土政权的所在地。

en.s: The Battle of Sesimbra Bay was a naval engagement that took place on 3 June 1602, during the Anglo-Spanish War. It was fought off the coast of Portugal (then within the Iberian Union) between an English naval expeditionary force sent out with orders by Queen Elizabeth I to prevent any further Spanish incursions against Ireland or England itself.

zh.s: 1602年6月3日，英西战争期间，英格兰与西班牙舰队在葡萄牙海岸外、当时处于伊比利亚联合王国统治之下的海域交战。英格兰远征舰队奉伊丽莎白一世女王之命出征，任务是阻止西班牙进一步入侵爱尔兰或英格兰。

en.s: The Battle of Tennōji (天王寺・岡山の戦い, Tennōji Okayama no tatakai) was fought on 3 June, 1615 between the forces of Tokugawa Ieyasu and Toyotomi Hideyori. Tokugawa was besieging Osaka, and Hideyori had planned a counterattack. Both sides were plagued by mistakes until Hideyori's side finally fell. He presumably committed suicide. The Toyotomi army suffered nearly 50% casualties in this battle, with more than 15,000 dead.

zh.s: 1615年6月3日，德川家康与丰臣秀赖的军队在天王寺·冈山之战中交战，日语称“天王寺・岡山の戦い”（Tennōji Okayama no tatakai）。德川军当时正在围攻大阪，秀赖计划反击。双方都出现失误，最终秀赖一方溃败。他据推测自杀。丰臣军在此战中几乎损失一半兵力，阵亡超过15,000人。

en.s: The Dunoon massacre was a massacre that took place around Dunoon, Scotland, on 3 June 1646. Men of Clan Campbell massacred men, women and children of the Clan Lamont. By 1646, the Clan Campbell, neighbours of the Clan Lamont, had steadily encroached the Lamont's lands. After the 1645 Battle of Inverlochy near Fort William, the Clan Lamont took the opportunity to lay waste to the Campbell's territory.

zh.s: 1646年6月3日，苏格兰杜努恩附近发生大屠杀。坎贝尔氏族成员杀害了拉蒙特氏族的男人、女人和儿童。到1646年时，作为邻居的坎贝尔氏族不断侵占拉蒙特氏族的土地。1645年因弗洛希战役在威廉堡附近结束后，拉蒙特氏族趁机蹂躏坎贝尔氏族的领地。

en.t: James Stuart, Duke of York (later to become King James II of England), defeats the Dutch fleet off the coast of Lowestoft
en.s: James II and VII (14 October 1633 O.S. – 16 September 1701) was King of England and Ireland as James II and King of Scotland as James VII from February 1685 until he was deposed in the 1688 Glorious Revolution. The last Catholic monarch of England, Scotland, and Ireland, his reign was marked by conflicts over religion, absolutism and the divine right of kings; his deposition ended a century of political and civil strife by confirming the primacy of the English Parliament over the Crown.

zh.t: 约克公爵詹姆斯·斯图亚特（后来的英格兰国王詹姆斯二世）在洛斯托夫特海岸击败荷兰舰队
zh.s: 詹姆斯二世（苏格兰称詹姆斯七世；1633年10月14日〔旧历〕—1701年9月16日）自1685年2月起担任英格兰和爱尔兰国王及苏格兰国王，直至1688年光荣革命中被废黜。他是英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰最后一位天主教君主；其统治因宗教、专制主义和君权神授问题而冲突不断。他的下台结束了持续一个世纪的政治与内乱，并确认议会地位高于王权。

en.s: The Battle of Chedabucto occurred against Fort St. Louis in Chedabucto (present-day Guysborough, Nova Scotia) on June 3, 1690, during King William's War (1689–97). The battle was part of Sir William Phips and New England's military campaign against Acadia. New England sent an overwhelming force to conquer Acadia by capturing the capital Port Royal, Chedabucto, and attacking other villages.

zh.s: 1690年6月3日，威廉王战争（1689—1697年）期间，切达布克托的圣路易斯堡遭到进攻，战斗发生在今加拿大新斯科舍省盖斯伯勒一带。这场战斗是威廉·菲普斯爵士和新英格兰军队对阿卡迪亚发动军事行动的一部分。新英格兰派出大军，计划攻占阿卡迪亚首府皇家港和切达布克托，并袭击其他村镇。

en.s: The Battle of Savitaipal took place on June 3, 1790 during the Russo-Swedish War (1788–90), between Sweden and the Russian Empire. The Swedes lost the battle and had to withdraw with a loss of 372 men killed, wounded and captured or 750 according to Russian sources. The Russians estimated their casualties at 60 men killed and wounded, whereas the Swedes claimed to have killed 800.

zh.s: 1790年6月3日，瑞典与俄罗斯帝国在俄瑞战争（1788—1790年）期间于萨维泰帕莱交战。瑞典战败并撤退，损失372人，包含阵亡、受伤或被俘者；俄方则称瑞典损失750人。俄方估计己方阵亡和受伤共60人，瑞典方面则声称杀死了800名俄军。

en.s: The 1793 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on June 3, 1793, in order to elect the Governor of New Jersey. Federalist candidate Richard Howell was elected by the New Jersey General Assembly against fellow Federalist candidate and incumbent United States Senator from New Jersey Frederick Frelinghuysen and candidate John Rutherford.

zh.s: 新泽西州于1793年6月3日举行州长选举。联邦党人理查德·豪厄尔由新泽西州议会选为州长，击败同为联邦党人的候选人、时任新泽西州联邦参议员弗雷德里克·弗雷林海森，以及约翰·卢瑟福。

en.s: The Battle of Gosselies or Battle of Charleroi (3 June 1794) saw a Republican French army co-commanded by Jacques Desjardin and Louis Charbonnier try to cross the Sambre River against a joint Dutch and Habsburg Austrian army under William, Hereditary Prince of Orange. The French defeat in the battle marked the third of five attempts by their armies to win a foothold on the north bank of the Sambre during the War of the First Coalition.

zh.s: 1794年6月3日，戈瑟利耶战役（又称沙勒罗瓦战役）中，由雅克·德雅尔丹和路易·沙博尼耶共同指挥的法国共和军试图渡过桑布尔河，与威廉王子率领的荷兰和哈布斯堡奥地利联军交战。法国战败。这是第一次反法同盟战争期间，法军五次试图在桑布尔河北岸立足中的第三次。

en.s: The siege of Taganrog is a name given in some Russian histories to Anglo-French naval operations in the Sea of Azov between June and November 1855 during the Crimean War. British and French forces were implementing a strategy of destroying the supply lines for the main Russian army which ran through the Sea of Azov. Taganrog was one of the major logistical hubs of the Russian army and was attacked and its military depot destroyed on 3 June 1855 as part of a series of attacks on all major Russian supply bases in the area, except Rostov-on-Don, which could not be reached due to the large shoals not admitting any available warship.

zh.s: “塔甘罗格围城战”是部分俄罗斯史籍对克里米亚战争期间1855年6月至11月英法两国在亚速海开展海军行动的称呼。英法军队执行一项战略，试图摧毁俄罗斯主力军经由亚速海的补给线。塔甘罗格是俄军重要的后勤枢纽之一，1855年6月3日遭到攻击，军事仓库被摧毁；这是英法对该地区俄罗斯主要补给基地进行一系列袭击的一部分。顿河畔罗斯托夫未遭攻击，因为浅滩太多，现有军舰无法抵达。

In 1859 there were two main crossing points over the Ticino near Magenta. The main road and rail bridges crossed the river just to the west of Magenta.

zh.s: 1859年6月3日，特尔比戈战役中，法国军队夺取了蒂契诺河上的两个渡河点，从而在奥地利统治的伦巴第站稳脚跟。1859年，马真塔附近有两个主要渡河点。主要公路桥和铁路桥位于马真塔以西。

en.s: The Battle of Philippi formed part of the Western Virginia Campaign of the American Civil War and was fought in and around Philippi, Virginia (now West Virginia), on June 3, 1861. A Union Army victory, it was the first organized land action of the war but is generally viewed as a skirmish rather than a battle. The Northern press, however, celebrated it as an epic triumph, which encouraged Congress to call for the drive on Richmond that ended with the Union defeat at First Bull Run in July. It brought overnight fame to Maj. Gen. George B.

zh.s: 美国内战西弗吉尼亚战役的一部分，菲利皮战役于1861年6月3日在弗吉尼亚州（今西弗吉尼亚州）菲利皮及周边地区进行。北军获胜，这是战争中首次有组织的陆上行动，但通常被视为小规模交战而非大战。北方媒体却将其宣传为重大胜利，促使国会推动进军里士满，最终北军于7月的第一次布尔朗河战役中战败。这场胜利也让乔治·B·麦克莱伦少将一举成名；该战还以首次战地截肢而著称。

en.s: The Battle of Nagoszewo was a clash between Polish rebel forces and units of the Imperial Russian Army during the January Uprising. It took place on 2–3 June 1863 near the village of Nagoszewo, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. Rebel forces, commanded by Maksymilian Broniewski fought off three columns of Russian troops. The rebels were reinforced by local peasants, who joined them.

en.s: The Gettysburg campaign was a military invasion of Pennsylvania by the main Confederate army under General Robert E. Lee in summer 1863. It was the first time during the war the Confederate Army attempted a full-scale invasion of a free state. The Union won a decisive victory at Gettysburg, July 1–3, with heavy casualties on both sides. Lee managed to escape back to Virginia with most of his army.

en.s: The 1878–79 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between June 3, 1878, and September 3, 1879. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives before or after the first session of the 46th United States Congress convened on March 18, 1879. en.s: The Battle of Loon Lake, also known as the Battle of Steele Narrows, concluded the North-West Rebellion on June 3, 1885, and was the last battle fought on Canadian soil. It was fought in what was then the District of Saskatchewan of the North-West Territories, at what is now known as Steele Narrows at Makwa Lake, in Saskatchewan's Steele Narrows Provincial Park.

zh.s: 卢恩湖战役又称斯蒂尔海峡战役，于1885年6月3日结束西北叛乱，是加拿大本土发生的最后一场战役。战斗发生在当时西北地区萨斯喀彻温区内的斯蒂尔海峡，即今加拿大萨斯喀彻温省麦夸湖的斯蒂尔海峡省立公园一带。

Important events included the Frog Lake incident, and the capture of Batoche. The North-West Rebellion began in March 1885 after Louis Riel returned from political exile in the U.S.

en.t: Liverpool F.C. is founded by John Houlding
en.s: Liverpool Football Club is a professional football club based in Liverpool, Merseyside, England. The club competes in the Premier League, the top tier of English football. Founded in 1892, the club joined the Football League the following year and has played its home games at Anfield since its formation. Liverpool is one of the most valuable and widely supported clubs in the world.

zh.s: 利物浦足球俱乐部是一家位于英格兰默西赛德郡利物浦的职业足球俱乐部，参加英格兰足球顶级联赛英超。俱乐部成立于1892年，次年加入足球联赛，自创立以来一直在安菲尔德进行主场比赛。利物浦是全球最具价值、支持者最多的俱乐部之一。

en.s: The Li–Lobanov Treaty or the Sino-Russian Secret Treaty (Chinese: 中俄密約; Russian: Союзный договор между Российской империей и Китаем) was a secret and unequal treaty signed on June 3, 1896 in Moscow by foreign minister Alexey Lobanov-Rostovsky on behalf of the Russian Empire and viceroy Li Hongzhang on behalf of Qing China. The treaty and its consequences increased anti-foreign sentiment in China, which came to a head in the Boxer Uprising of 1900.

zh.s: 李—罗拔诺夫条约又称《中俄密约》（俄语：Союзный договор между Российской империей и Китаем），是俄罗斯帝国外交部长阿列克谢·洛巴诺夫-罗斯托夫斯基与清朝代表李鸿章于1896年6月3日在莫斯科签署的一项秘密且不平等的条约。该条约及其后果加剧了中国的排外情绪，并在1900年义和团运动期间达到高峰。

en.s: Edward VIII (Edward Albert Christian George Andrew Patrick David; 23 June 1894 – 28 May 1972), later known as the Duke of Windsor, was King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and Emperor of India, from 20 January 1936 until his abdication in December of the same year. zh.t: 温莎公爵（前英国国王爱德华八世）与沃利斯·辛普森结婚
zh.s: 爱德华八世（爱德华·阿尔伯特·克里斯蒂安·乔治·安德鲁·帕特里克·大卫；1894年6月23日—1972年5月28日），后来称温莎公爵，于1936年1月20日至同年12月退位期间担任英国及其自治领国王和印度皇帝。他出生于维多利亚女王在位期间，是约克公爵和公爵夫人的长子；父母后来成为乔治五世国王和玛丽王后。

en.s: Unternehmen Paula (Operation Paula) is the German codename for a Luftwaffe operation to destroy the remaining units of the Armée de l'Air (AdA, French Air Force) during the Battle of France in 1940. On 10 May the German armed forces (Wehrmacht) began their invasion of Western Europe. By 3 June, the bulk of the British Army had withdrawn from Dunkirk Operation Dynamo, the Netherlands and Belgium had surrendered and most of the formations of the French Army were disbanded or destroyed. To complete the defeat of France, the Germans undertook another operation, Fall Rot (Case Red), to conquer the remaining regions. To achieve this, air supremacy was required. The Luftwaffe was ordered to destroy the French Air Forces and support to the German Army. The Germans committed five Air Corps to the attack, comprising 1,100 aircraft. The operation was launched on 3 June 1940.

zh.s: “保拉行动”（Unternehmen Paula）是德国空军在1940年法国战役期间的一项行动代号，目标是摧毁法国空军（Armée de l'Air，AdA）的残余力量。5月10日，德国武装部队开始入侵西欧。到6月3日，英国主体部队已在“发电机行动”中从敦刻尔克撤离，荷兰和比利时已投降，法国陆军的大部分部队已解散或被击溃。为彻底击败法国，德国开始实施“红色方案”，征服法国剩余地区。为此必须取得制空权。德国空军奉命摧毁法国空军并支援德军，投入五个航空军团、共1,100架飞机。行动于1940年6月3日展开。

en.s: The village of Kandanos in Western Crete, Greece, was completely destroyed and about 180 of its inhabitants killed on 3 June 1941 by German occupying forces during World War II. It was ordered by Generaloberst Kurt Student in reprisal for the participation of the local population in the Battle of Crete that had held advancing German soldiers for two days. The destruction constituted one of the most atrocious war crimes committed during the occupation of Crete by Axis forces in World War II.

zh.s: 1941年6月3日，德国占领军彻底摧毁了希腊克里特岛西部的坎达诺斯村，并杀害约180名村民。此次行动由德国国防军上将库尔特·施图登下令，目的是报复当地居民在克里特岛战役中阻挡德军推进两天。二战期间德国占领克里特岛时，这次摧毁行动是轴心国犯下的最严重战争罪行之一。

en.s: The Aleutian Islands campaign (Japanese: アリューシャン方面の戦い, romanized: Alyūshan hōmen no tatakai) was a military campaign fought between 3 June 1942 and 15 August 1943 on and around the Aleutian Islands, part of the US Territory of Alaska, in the American Theater of World War II during the Pacific War. It was the only military campaign of World War II fought on North American soil.

zh.s: 阿留申群岛战役（日本语：アリューシャン方面の戦い，罗马字：Alyūshan hōmen no tatakai）是第二次世界大战太平洋战场美国战区的一场战役，1942年6月3日至1943年8月15日在美国阿拉斯加领地的阿留申群岛及周边地区进行。这是第二次世界大战期间唯一在北美本土进行的军事战役。

en.t: At a press conference on 3 June 1947, Lord Mountbatten announced the date of independence – 14 August 1947 – and also outlined the actual division of British India between the two new dominions in what became known as the "Mountbatten Plan" or the "3 June Plan"
en.s: The partition of India in 1947 was the division of British India into two independent dominion states, the Union of India and Dominion of Pakistan. The Union of India is today the Republic of India, and the Dominion of Pakistan is the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and the People's Republic of Bangladesh. The partition involved the division of two provinces, Bengal and the Punjab, based on district-wide non-Muslim (mostly Hindu and Sikh) or Muslim majorities.

zh.s: 1947年6月3日，蒙巴顿勋爵在记者会上宣布印度将于1947年8月14日独立，并说明英属印度将如何划分为两个新自治领。这一方案后来被称为“蒙巴顿计划”或“6月3日计划”。1947年印度分治将英属印度划分为印度自治领和巴基斯坦自治领两个独立自治领。印度自治领后来成为印度共和国；巴基斯坦自治领后来分为巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国和孟加拉人民共和国。分治按各县非穆斯林（主要为印度教徒和锡克教徒）或穆斯林占多数的情况，将孟加拉和旁遮普两省分割。

en.s: The 1950 French Annapurna expedition, led by Maurice Herzog, reached the summit of Annapurna I at 8,091 metres (26,545 ft), the highest peak in the Annapurna Massif. The mountain is in Nepal and the government had given permission for the expedition, the first time it had permitted mountaineering in over a century. en.s: Air France Flight 007 crashed on 3 June 1962 while on take-off from Orly Airport. The crash was at the time the worst single-aircraft disaster and the deadliest crash involving a Boeing 707.

en.s: The Huế chemical attacks occurred on 3 June 1963, when soldiers of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) poured liquid chemicals from tear gas grenades onto the heads of praying Buddhists in Huế, South Vietnam. The Buddhists were protesting against religious discrimination by the regime of the Roman Catholic President Ngô Đình Diệm. The attacks caused 67 people to be hospitalised for blistering of the skin and respiratory ailments.

en.t: Gemini 4 launches and Ed White makes the first American spacewalk
en.s: James McDivitt and Ed White launched aboard Gemini 4 from Cape Kennedy, Florida, beginning a four-day mission in Earth orbit. Later that day, White left the capsule while attached by a tether, becoming the first American to walk in space. The crew completed 66 orbits and carried out scientific experiments, extending American experience with longer human spaceflights. McDivitt also attempted to approach the spent upper stage of their launch vehicle, but the attempted rendezvous was unsuccessful. The flight helped NASA develop techniques and operational experience for later Gemini missions and the Apollo programme. The mission returned to Earth on June 7.

zh.t: 双子星4号发射，埃德·怀特完成美国首次太空行走
zh.s: 詹姆斯·麦克迪维特和埃德·怀特乘坐双子星4号从佛罗里达州肯尼迪角发射升空，开始为期四天的地球轨道任务。当天晚些时候，怀特系着安全绳离开舱体，成为首位进行太空行走的美国人。两名宇航员绕地球飞行66圈，并开展科学实验，为美国执行更长时间的载人航天任务积累了经验。麦克迪维特还尝试接近运载火箭已经用过的上面级，但未能成功交会。此次飞行帮助NASA为后续双子星任务和阿波罗计划积累技术与操作经验。飞船于6月7日返回地球。

en.s: A leadership election was held on 3 June 1965 to elect the leader of Mapai. It saw the party's Central Committee vote to reelect incumbent party leader and prime minister Levi Eshkol, with Eshkol defeating former party leader (and founder) and former prime minister David Ben-Gurion. Ben-Gurion challenged Eshkol, who had been his hand-picked successor two years prior, after a feud arose between them regarding Ben-Gurion's desire for there to be a new investigation into the Lavon Affair.

zh.s: 马派于1965年6月3日举行领导人选举。该党中央委员会投票决定连任现任党魁、总理列维·埃希科尔。埃希科尔击败了马派前党魁兼创始人、前总理戴维·本-古里安。本-古里安曾在两年前亲自选定埃希科尔接班，后来两人因本-古里安要求重新调查拉冯事件而发生争执，他因此向埃希科尔发起挑战。

en.t: 1973 Paris Air Show Tupolev Tu-144 crash
en.s: On 3 June 1973, the second production model of the Soviet supersonic Tupolev Tu-144 airliner was destroyed in a crash during the 1973 Paris Air Show at Le Bourget Airport. Whilst performing a display that included extreme manoeuvres, the aircraft stalled at low altitude, and during the attempted recovery disintegrated in mid-air, falling on the town of Goussainville, Val-d'Oise, France, killing all six crew members and eight people on the ground. The crash ended the development program of the Tupolev Tu-144. The official inquest did not conclusively determine the cause of the accident, and several theories have been proposed.

zh.t: 1973年巴黎航展图-144客机坠毁事故
zh.s: 1973年6月3日，苏联图-144超音速客机的第二架量产机在1973年巴黎航展期间于勒布尔热机场坠毁。飞机进行包括大幅度机动在内的飞行表演时，在低空失速；试图改出时，机体在空中解体，坠落到法国瓦兹河谷省古桑维尔镇，机上6名机组人员和地面8人全部遇难。事故终结了图-144的研制计划。官方调查未能确定事故原因，之后出现了多种推测。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on June 3, 1979. This election was called just a week before the European vote: the lack of matching between the two elections caused much controversy for wasting public money. Terroristic attacks by the Red Brigades caused a result which was quite opposite than three years before: for the first time the Italian Communist Party lost a lot of votes, delaying that government change that was seeming imminent in 1976, and the Communist defeat gave a new strength to all the minor parties, a concentration of vote on the Christian Democracy seeming less urgent to stop the red progress.

en.s: The 1991 eruption of Mount Unzen (Japanese: 1991年の雲仙岳噴火) is the volcanic disaster caused by the eruption of Mount Unzen in Nagasaki Prefecture, Japan. Volcanic activity began in November 1990, and a large-scale pyroclastic flow occurred on June 3, 1991, causing extensive damage. In total, 43 people were either killed or have disappeared. The volcanic activity finally subsided in 1995. Until the 2014 eruption of Mount Ontake, the event was the deadliest volcanic disaster in post-war Japan. The event is known in Japanese as the Heisei eruption (平成大噴火, Heisei daifunka).

zh.s: 1991年云仙岳喷发是日本长崎县云仙岳喷发引发的火山灾害。火山活动始于1990年11月，1991年6月3日发生大规模火山碎屑流，造成严重损失。共有43人死亡或失踪。火山活动到1995年才最终平息。2014年御岳山喷发之前，这是日本战后死亡人数最多的火山灾害。日语称这次事件为“平成大喷发”（平成大噴火，Heisei daifunka）。

en.s: On 3 June 1998, part of an ICE 1 train on the Hanover–Hamburg railway near Eschede in Lower Saxony, Germany, derailed and crashed into an overpass that crossed the railroad, which then collapsed onto the train. 101 people were killed and at least 88 were injured, making it the second-deadliest railway disaster in German history after the 1939 Genthin rail disaster, and the world's worst ever high-speed rail disaster. The cause of the derailment was a single fatigue crack in one wheel, which caused a part of the wheel to become caught in a railroad switch (points), changing the direction of the switch as the train passed over it.

zh.s: 1998年6月3日，一列ICE 1列车在德国下萨克森州埃舍德附近的汉诺威—汉堡铁路线上脱轨，撞上跨越铁路的高架桥；桥梁随后坍塌，砸在列车上。事故造成101人死亡、至少88人受伤，是德国历史上仅次于1939年根廷铁路事故的第二严重铁路事故，也是世界上伤亡最严重的高速铁路事故。脱轨原因是一个车轮出现疲劳裂纹，导致部分轮体卡入道岔，并在列车通过时改变了道岔方向。

en.s: A primary election was held among the members of Costa Rica’s National Liberation Party (PLN) on June 3, 2001 in order to choose PLN’s nominee for presidency in the 2002 general election. en.s: Long Beach, California, held an election for mayor on April 8, 2014 and June 2, 2014. It saw the election of Robert Garcia. In winning, Garcia became the first openly gay person to be elected Mayor of Long Beach. Garcia is a Democrat, but was elected without a party affiliation, as municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan. Incumbent Bob Foster was term limited.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州长滩市于2014年4月8日和6月2日举行市长选举，罗伯特·加西亚当选。加西亚也因此成为长滩首位公开同性恋身份的市长。虽然加西亚是民主党人，但因加利福尼亚州市政选举不设党派，他以无党派身份当选。现任市长鲍勃·福斯特因任期限制不能参选。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Latvia on 3 June 2015. Raimonds Vējonis of the Green Party was elected President, to take office on 8 July. According to the European Green Party, he is the first of their members to become a head of state of a European Union member state.

en.s: The Battle of Marinka was a short battle in the war in Donbas in and around Marinka, Donetsk Oblast which took place on 3 June 2015. Ukrainian forces fought the self-proclaimed Donetsk People's Republic's (DPR) Republican Guard and Pyatnashka Brigade under Akhra Avidzba. The town of Marinka was briefly seized by DPR forces before it was recaptured by the Ukrainians.

zh.s: 2015年6月3日，顿巴斯战争期间，乌克兰军队与自封的顿涅茨克人民共和国（DPR）共和卫队及阿赫拉·阿维兹巴领导的“十五人旅”在顿涅茨克州马林卡及周边地区发生短暂战斗。DPR部队一度占领该镇，后被乌克兰军队夺回。

en.s: The 2015 Hawija bombing was a controversial military airstrike carried out by the Royal Netherlands Air Force at 00:02 local time during the night of 2–3 June 2015, as a central component of Operation Inherent Resolve, the international coalition campaign against ISIS. Executed by two Dutch F-16s, the mission targeted an ISIS vehicle-borne improvised explosive device factory and weapons storage facility located in the industrial neighbourhood of Hawija, Iraq.

zh.s: 2015年6月2日至3日夜间当地时间00:02，荷兰皇家空军对伊拉克哈维杰工业区发动空袭，成为国际联盟“固有决心行动”打击ISIS行动的重要组成部分。这次有争议的军事空袭由两架荷兰F-16执行，目标是ISIS的汽车炸弹制造厂和武器储存设施。

en.s: General elections were held in Malta on Saturday, 3 June 2017 to elect all members of the House of Representatives. en.s: The Khartoum massacre occurred on 3 June 2019, when the armed forces of the Sudanese Transitional Military Council, headed by the Lieutenant-General Abdel Fattah Abdelrahman Burhan of the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and his deputy, Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo of the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), the immediate successor organisation to the Janjaweed militia, used heavy gunfire and tear gas to disperse a sit-in by protestors in Khartoum, killing over 100 people. It has been difficult to assess the actual number killed. At least forty bodies were thrown in the River Nile.

en.s: The 2025 mayoral election in Jackson, Mississippi was held on June 3, 2025, alongside other Jackson municipal races. Primary elections were held on April 1, with incumbent mayor Chokwe Antar Lumumba and state senator John Horhn advancing to a runoff which was held on April 22. Horne defeated Lumumba in the runoff and achieved a large majority in the general election, being declared the mayor-elect on election night.

en.s: The 2025 Gulfport mayoral election was held on June 3, 2025, to elect the mayor of Gulfport, Mississippi. Incumbent mayor Billy Hewes was eligible for re-election to a second four-year term, but announced that he would retire. Primary elections were held on April 1, 2025. Former Democratic member of the Mississippi House of Representatives Sonya Williams-Barnes won her party's primary, defeating former professional basketball player Ronnie Henderson, and Republican attorney Hugh Keating won his party's nomination unopposed.

en.s: The 2025 Prince George's County executive special election was held on June 3, 2025, to fill in the last two years of Prince George's County executive Angela Alsobrooks's term, who resigned on December 2, 2024, following her election to the U.S. Senate. Upon her resignation, the county's chief administrative officer, Tara Jackson, became the acting county executive.
